gemini-2.5-flash.notes: Correctly identifies no CRA triggers but has significant accuracy issues with CVE counts (reports 39 vs actual 61 unique CVEs). Good structure and actionable recommendations but contains potential hallucinated CVEs.

deepseek-v3.notes: Excellent CRA compliance awareness, accurate CVE counts (61 total), comprehensive coverage of critical findings, very concise format, and well-prioritized actions. Minor deduction for not explicitly mentioning Article 14 deadlines.

analysis: Deepseek-v3 significantly outperforms with accurate CVE counting (61 vs 39), better conciseness, and superior technical precision. While both correctly identify no CRA mandatory triggers, Deepseek provides more reliable data and clearer prioritization of remediation actions.
